blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Mobile robots and vehicles carry synchronized multi-camera rigs, yet many streaming 3D foundation models are designed for monocular input, leaving efficient use of rig geometry a challenge. We present StreamRig, a freeze-and-stream framework that builds causal streaming odometry for calibrated rigs on a frozen multi-view 3D foundation model. The frozen front-end jointly perceives the synchronized views using rig calibration. A Rig-Resampler compresses their features, a CausalBridge applies causal attention with a key-value cache, and a lightweight head regresses rig poses. A periodic re-anchoring protocol supports stable pose estimation over long sequences. Only these modules are trained, 74.6 M parameters in total, with relative poses as the sole supervision. Our two-stage training strategy combines group relocalization pretraining with causal rig training to transfer the geometric priors of the frozen front-end and the alignment ability of the pretrained modules to streaming odometry. We evaluate on NCLT, TartanGround, KITTI-360, and our self-collected humanoid-robot dataset ZJH, where training uses only simulation and real-world evaluation is zero-shot. Across all four datasets, StreamRig achieves lower translation and rotation drift than the evaluated non-oracle monocular streaming and rig-aware offline models, while maintaining low inference cost. Ablations and controlled camera-count experiments identify the sources of these gains. We further examine how longer training windows affect inference over longer horizons.
Code has been released at https://github.com/WeiYuFei0217/StreamRig .

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Mobile robots and autonomous vehicles often carry synchronized multi-camera rigs for surround awareness. Their complementary views support motion estimation when an individual view degrades, while known calibration relates the cameras within the rig. Using these observations online requires causal odometry that treats each rig jointly and estimates motion from current and past inputs with bounded memory and latency.
blocks.zh: 移动机器人和自主车辆经常搭载同步多相机钻机来进行周边的认知. 它们的补充观点支持单个视图退化时的运动估计,而已知的校正则与钻机内的相机有关。 在线使用这些观测数据需要因果测量,将每个钻机合并处理,并用有限度的内存和耐久性估计当前和过去输入的运动。

blocks.en: Classical multi-camera odometry models the rig as a generalized camera within an optimization pipeline [ 1 , 2 ] , but relies on hand-crafted features and careful per-platform engineering. Dynamic, repetitive, and texture-poor scenes remain difficult. 3D foundation models offer geometric priors learned from broad data [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Recent streaming models produce poses causally from monocular video [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] . Extending this capability to calibrated multi-camera rigs presents two challenges.
blocks.zh: 古典多相机平面模型 该钻机作为通用相机 在优化的管道 [1,2],但依赖手制地物和仔细的每个平台工程. 动态的、重复的和纹理贫乏的场景仍然很困难。 3D地基模型提供从广义数据中吸取的几何前传[3,4,5]. 近期流出型号的出品从单相声视频中呈现出因果[6,7,8,9,10]. 将这种能力扩大到校正多相机钻机是两项挑战。

blocks.en: The first is to exploit geometry within each rig while keeping temporal inference affordable. Feeding synchronized views into a monocular streamer as separate frames increases the number of tokens processed at each time step. For methods that cache past tokens, it also enlarges the persistent state. Yet this input representation does not explicitly encode the known geometric relations among cameras observing at the same instant. A rig-level streamer must use those relations jointly without carrying all image tokens through its temporal history.
blocks.zh: 第一是利用每个钻机内的几何特征,同时使时间推论负担得起。 将同步视图输入到一个单相交流流器中,因为单独的帧会增加每个时段处理的令牌数量. 对于缓存过符号的方法,它也会扩大持久性状态. 然而,这种输入表示并没有明确编码同一瞬间观测的相机之间已知的几何关系。 钻机级流线器必须共同使用这些关系,而不会在其时间历史中携带所有图像符号。

blocks.en: The second is to learn reliable motion estimation from limited rig data. Training a dedicated model from scratch requires both geometric perception and temporal reasoning, but real rig datasets typically provide sparse LiDAR depth, with dense geometric supervision largely confined to simulation. Camera layouts also vary little within each dataset, a limitation noted by Rig3R [ 11 ] . Freezing a pretrained front-end removes the need to relearn its 3D representation, but does not by itself teach a new pose back-end to use that representation. Our initialization ablation shows that a randomly initialized back-end learns motion poorly when trained directly on causal rig sequences (Sec. IV-D ).
blocks.zh: 第二是从有限的钻机数据中学习可靠的运动估计. 从零开始培训专用模型既需要几何感知,也需要时间推理,但真正的钻机数据集通常提供稀疏的LiDAR深度,密集的几何监督主要局限于模拟. 相机布局在每个数据集内部也变化不大,由Rig3R [11]所注意到的限制. 冻结预先训练的前端可以消除重新学习其3D代表的必要性,但本身并不会教一个新的后端姿势来使用这种代表. 我们的初始化衰减表明,一个随机初始化的后端在直接接受因果钻机序列(Sec. IV-D.)训练时学习运动效果不佳.

blocks.en: Our key insight is to adapt pretrained geometry to streaming through a compact pose back-end. Odometry needs geometric cues that constrain motion, rather than dense reconstruction of every observation, making compact representations suitable for temporal reasoning. Stage I pretrains this back-end on group relocalization: estimating the relative pose between two groups of views sampled along camera trajectories. Sampling view groups across sessions and trajectories exposes the back-end to diverse geometries and displacements beyond a single fixed rig layout. Stage II adapts this learned group alignment to causal rig sequences while preserving the frozen front-end’s geometric prior.
blocks.zh: 我们的关键洞察力是调整预受训练的几何学 通过紧凑的后端来流出 Odometry需要限制运动的几何提示,而不是每次观测的密集重建,使紧凑的表述适合时间推理. 第一阶段预留这个后端 在组重新定位: 估计两个组之间的相对姿势 沿相机轨迹取样。 横跨会话和轨迹的采样取景组将后端暴露出各种地貌和异地取景,超出了单一固定钻机布局. 第二阶段在保留被冻结的前端几何前端的同时,使这种学习到的组合配合因果钻机序列。

blocks.en: In this paper, we present StreamRig, a freeze-and-stream framework using this insight. To our knowledge, it is the first streaming odometer to transfer a frozen multi-view 3D foundation model to general multi-camera rigs. Its frozen front-end jointly encodes synchronized images with their intrinsics and rig extrinsics. The Rig-Resampler compresses each camera’s features into a few latent tokens. The CausalBridge reasons over this history with a per-query copy of the anchor tokens, an anchor snapshot , allowing anchor and query to attend to each other without accessing future observations. Intervening rigs provide geometric context when anchor and query no longer share a view. Poses are estimated relative to the anchor, and the re-anchoring protocol periodically advances it to bound the state. Only the compact back-end is trained, using relative pose supervision alone. Mixed-length windows and displacement-normalized translation supervision balance learning across motion ranges.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出了StreamRig,一个使用这种见解的冻结和流出框架。 据我们所知,这是第一个将被冻结的多视距三维基模型转移到普通多相机钻机的流出气压计。 它的被冻结的前端 联合编码了它们的内在图像 和外接装置的同步图像 Rig-Resampler将每台相机的特性压缩成几个潜在的符号. Causal Bridge在历史中的原因, 当锚地和查询不再共享视图时,干涉钻机提供了几何上下文. 与锚相比,可能性是估计的,重新锁定协议定期推进它来约束国家. 只有紧凑后端经过训练,仅使用相对的外观监督. 混合长窗和相位常态化的翻译监督在运动范围学习之间保持平衡。

blocks.en: We evaluate on four rigs: a surround rig on NCLT, a four-way ring on TartanGround, stereo with side fisheyes on KITTI-360, and a humanoid-robot rig. The humanoid experiment tests transfer from simulation to the real robot without training on real-robot data. Figure 1 illustrates the trajectory improvement on NCLT and separately measured runtime costs. Controlled camera-count comparisons and ablations isolate the benefits of joint rig perception, pretraining, anchor interaction, and the training recipe. Replacing the frozen front-end tests the transfer recipe beyond one foundation model. Re-anchoring and training-horizon studies show that longer training windows extend the usable anchor range at greater training cost.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了四套钻机:NCLT的环形钻机、TartanGround的四向环、KITTI-360上有副鱼眼的立体声以及人造机器人钻机。 人机实验试验从模拟转移到了真正的机器人,没有接受过关于真机器人数据的培训. 图1说明了NCLT的轨迹改进情况以及单独计量的运行时间成本。 控制下的相机计数比较和模拟将联合钻机感知、预训、锚地互动和培训配方的效益隔离开来。 取代被冷冻的前端测试 转移食谱超出一个基础模型。 重新挑选和培训范围研究显示,较长的培训窗口以更高的培训成本扩大可用的锚地范围。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • Rig-level causal streaming odometry. StreamRig combines calibrated multi-view perception with compressed temporal reasoning and re-anchoring for online pose estimation with bounded streaming state. • A data-efficient transfer recipe. Group relocalization pretrains a compact pose back-end for causal adaptation on top of a frozen 3D foundation model, using pose supervision alone. • Accuracy and efficiency across four rigs. StreamRig achieves the lowest translation and rotation drift among evaluated non-oracle methods on all four rigs; separately measured five-camera inference requires less memory and has lower latency than monocular CUT3R.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: StreamRig将校正多视图感知与压缩时间推理相结合,并重新确定在线布置与有界流态的相接估计. • 具有数据效率的传输方法。 组合重新定位预留一个紧凑式在被冻结的3D地基模型上呈现出因果适应的后端,仅使用姿势监督. • 四个钻机的准确性和效率。 StreamRig在所有四个钻机上都实现了被评价的非甲骨文方法中最小的翻译和旋转漂移;单独测量的五相机推论需要较少的内存并具有比单相机CUT3R更低的延迟.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Multi-camera odometry. Multiple cameras widen the field of view and add redundancy when one view degrades. The generalized camera model [ 1 ] treats a calibrated rig as one imaging device, supporting odometry with little or no view overlap [ 2 ] and keyframe SLAM with arbitrary rig layouts [ 12 , 13 ] . These systems recover motion by iterative optimization over explicit geometric residuals [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 多相机显相. 多个相机拓宽了视野,并在一个视图退化时添加冗余. 通用相机模型 [1] 将被校准的钻机作为一款成像装置处理,支持视线很少或没有重叠的斜面测量[2]和键框 SLAM与任意的钻机布局[12,13]. 这些系统通过迭代优化来恢复运动,比显式几何残基 [14].

blocks.en: Feed-forward 3D foundation models learn geometric priors from large, diverse data to predict geometry and camera parameters in one pass. DUSt3R [ 3 ] predicts dense pointmaps for an uncalibrated image pair, and Reloc3R [ 15 ] estimates relative poses. VGGT [ 4 ] and π 3 \pi^{3} [ 16 ] jointly process image collections, the latter without a reference view. Beyond RGB-only inputs, MapAnything [ 5 ] , Depth Anything 3 [ 17 ] , and the Pi3X release of π 3 \pi^{3} accept known camera geometry. Rig3R [ 11 ] explicitly conditions on rig metadata: camera identity, timestamps, and rig-relative rays. It demonstrates the benefit of rig priors but identifies limited diversity in training data, particularly in rig configurations, as a key limitation. The group-to-group formulation of [ 18 ] freezes the backbone and trains lightweight modules to estimate the rigid transform between two image groups with known intra-group geometry. This enables joint rig perception conditioned on known intrinsics and extrinsics. These methods process fixed image sets without persistent state across calls.

VGGT [4] 和 * * 3\pi^{3} [16] 联合处理图像收藏,后者没有参考视图. 除了 RGB 仅输入外, Map Anything [5], Depth Anything 3 [17], Pi3X 的发布 * * 3\pi^{3} 接受已知相机几何. Rig3R[11]明确对钻机元数据的条件:相机身份,时间戳和钻机相接的射线. 它表明钻机前期的好处,但指出培训数据,特别是钻机配置方面的有限多样性是关键限制。 [18]的组到组配位会冻结主干并训练轻量级模块,以估计已知组内几何的两个图像组之间的刚性变换. 这使得联合钻机感知以已知的内在和外生物为条件。 这些方法处理固定的图像集,没有持续状态跨调用.

blocks.en: Streaming monocular 3D models process video causally with temporal state. Spann3R [ 19 ] uses external spatial memory queried by each new frame and pruned by attention weight, while CUT3R [ 6 ] maintains a fixed-size recurrent state. TTT3R [ 20 ] reweights state updates using confidence gating without retraining. StreamVGGT [ 7 ] and STream3R [ 8 ] use causal attention over cached keys and values. WinT3R [ 21 ] combines overlapping windows with one camera token per past frame. LingBot-Map [ 9 ] retains full anchor frames and compresses older frames into summary tokens. HorizonStream [ 10 ] combines a decaying recurrent state with a local window. Each processes one image per step and predicts camera parameters instead of using known calibration.

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: StreamRig is a causal streaming odometer for calibrated multi-camera rigs. It keeps a multi-view 3D foundation model frozen as the perception front-end and adds three lightweight modules that turn the per-rig perception into a causal state and read odometry out of it (Fig. 2 ). Only these modules are trained, with relative poses as their sole supervision.
blocks.zh: StreamRig是用于校准多相机钻机的因果流道气压计. 它保持了多视图3D基础模型被冻结作为感知前端,并增加了三个轻量级模块,将每刚感知转化为因果状态并读取了其中的odometry (图2). 只有这些单元得到培训,其唯一的监督是相对的。

blocks.en: Frozen rig perception. Each incoming rig is encoded once by MapAnything [ 5 ] , which receives the C C images, per-pixel ray directions computed from 𝐊 \mathbf{K} , and the extrinsics 𝐄 \mathbf{E} with the reference camera at identity. Inside, a DINOv2 encoder [ 22 ] tokenizes each image, the ray and pose encodings are fused into the tokens, and an alternating-attention transformer [ 4 ] exchanges information across the cameras. The output is a set of geometry-grounded patch features 𝐅 t ∈ ℝ C × P × D \mathbf{F}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times P\times D} , with P P patches per camera.

blocks.en: Rig-Resampler. Before temporal reasoning, the Rig-Resampler compresses each camera’s P P patch tokens into L = 16 L=16 latents using L L learnable queries and two cross-attention layers, giving 𝐙 t ∈ ℝ C × L × D \mathbf{Z}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times L\times D} . A five-camera rig is reduced from 1280 to 80 tokens, fewer than the 256 patches of one 224 2 224^{2} image, reducing temporal attention cost and cache size. Such compression targets the cues needed for motion and scale estimation rather than dense reconstruction. Sec. IV-D evaluates the trade-off between accuracy and cost at 8, 16, and 32 latents per camera.

blocks.en: Two-stage training. To avoid poor convergence from scratch, Stage I pretrains the three modules on group relocalization with bidirectional attention (Fig. 2 (b)). Only the input and the supervision change: rig windows with anchor snapshots replace the pair, the causal mask replaces bidirectional attention, and every query rig becomes a target. blocks.en: Re-anchoring protocol. With a fixed anchor, the state would grow with the sequence. The state then holds at most N N compressed rigs, or N ​ C ​ L N\,CL tokens, whatever the length of the sequence. Since the bridge accepts any window length, the block length N N is a deployment parameter and need not match a training window. Short blocks accumulate more hop errors; long blocks can exceed the learned translation range. Sec. IV-C evaluates this trade-off.
blocks.zh: 重新安抚协议. 有了固定的锚,州会随着序列而增长. 为了保持其定界,StrewRig在N钻机区块中的再锚:一个区块的最后一个钻机会成为下一个的锚地,窗口会在那里重启,而轨迹则由锚地到锚地的姿势所组成,每个轨迹都是Eq. (1)的一个输出. 然后状态最多持有N N 压缩钻机,或者N C L N\,CL 令牌,无论序列的长度如何. 由于桥接受任何窗口长度,区块长度N N是一个部署参数,不需要匹配训练窗口. 短块会累积更多的跳出错误;长块可以超过所学到的翻译范围. 四·C司评价这种取舍。

blocks.en: Optional long-history mode. The anchor can also stay fixed over a long stretch, which keeps the whole history addressable at the same per-step latency as re-anchoring. A rig more than 8 steps behind the current one keeps only the first four latents of every camera, the cache drops the keys and values of the rest, and training uses the matching banded mask. The state still grows with the sequence and the pruning costs short-range accuracy, so re-anchoring remains the default and this mode serves as a budget reference (Secs. IV-C and IV-E ).
blocks.zh: 可选长史模式. 锚也能够被固定在一个很长的长度上,这使得整个历史的可处理性保持在与再接续的相隔相仿的相隔时间. 超过8个台阶的钻机只保留每台相机的前4个潜伏,缓存会放下其余的键和值,而训练则使用相匹配的带状口罩. 状态仍然随着序列和普跑成本的短程精确度而增长,因此重排仍然是默认状态,而这种模式作为预算参考(Secs. IV-C和IV-E.).

blocks.en: Rigs. We evaluate on four rigs. NCLT [ 24 ] is a campus Segway with five co-centered surround cameras. We post-train on its eight training sessions and evaluate on the complete sessions 2012-02-19 and 2012-08-20. TartanGround [ 25 ] is a simulated ground robot with four co-located outward cameras. We evaluate the three longest trajectories of each of ten held-out scenes. KITTI-360 [ 26 ] is urban driving with a 0.59 m stereo pair and two side fisheyes rectified to 90 ∘ views. We train on drives 0000 and 0002–0007 and evaluate on 0009 and 0010. ZJH is our humanoid-robot dataset for sim-to-real transfer. Its rig has a 7 cm forward stereo pair and two oblique cameras covering about 180 ∘ in azimuth. Training uses only simulation, 131 walking trajectories in 25 indoor environments reconstructed from real scans with 3D Gaussian Splatting. Evaluation is zero-shot on three real sequences in unseen environments, with ground truth from a COLMAP rig reconstruction.

blocks.en: Protocol. Every method runs causally over each complete sequence, anchored to its first pose, and composes its trajectory from its own predictions. Except for the MA-AB oracle, ground-truth poses are used only for evaluation. Each method re-anchors in blocks of N N sampled rigs or frames, so N = 2 N{=}2 is a pairwise chain and a larger N N keeps a longer state.

The two KITTI-360 drives differ three-fold in length, so its metrics are pooled over both weighted by path length. Methods marked U in Table I are not trained on the target dataset or do not output metric scale. They receive one global Umeyama scale per sequence before t r ​ e ​ l t_{rel} and r r ​ e ​ l r_{rel} are computed, and their ATE follows Sim(3) alignment. All others run at raw metric scale, with ATE after SE(3) alignment. ZJH is the exception, since the scale between simulation and the real robot is unknown in advance, so there every method receives one global scale per sequence and shares one test stride.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们报告KITTI相对漂移,以%为单位,以每100米为单位,超过NCLT和KITTI-360的100-800米和TartanGround和ZJH的10-80米,以及按米计的全序ATE。 两种KITTI-360驱动器在长度上各有三倍不同,因此,其测量值与两者的路径长度相加。 表一中标出U的方法没有经过目标数据集的培训,也没有输出度量尺度。 在计算出t r e r r r r r r r 之前,它们每个序列得到一个全球Umeyama比例尺,它们的ATE跟随Sim (3) 对齐. 所有其他项目均按原始尺度运行,SE(3)调整后为ATE。 ZJH是例外,因为模拟和真正的机器人之间的尺度是事先未知的,因此,每种方法每个序列都得到一个全球尺度并共享一个测试步.

blocks.en: NCLT is the hardest rig. Its two 6 km sessions are real campus captures with indoor-outdoor transitions, lighting changes, motion blur, and pedestrians [ 24 ] . Surround perception of the rig first buys stable tracking here. G2G-chain keeps no state over time, yet it is second in the column and drifts less than every monocular streamer, fine-tuned or zero-shot. The streaming state then turns stable tracking into low drift. StreamRig sees the same images, calibration, and frozen features as the chain, but reads each rig against an anchor several rigs back through the causal history in between, so every estimate draws on more evidence and the anchor changes far less often. A chain re-estimates at every hop and composes the results, and composition accumulates error. Even MA-AB, given the true pose between the rigs of every pair, still drifts 46%, because a small systematic bias per pairwise estimate is composed over thousands of hops.
blocks.zh: NCLT是最难的钻机 它的两个6公里的会场是真实的校园捕捉,带有室内外过渡,照明变化,运动模糊,行人[24]. 对钻机的周边感知 首先是在这里购买稳定的跟踪。 G2G-链随时间推移而保持无状态,然而它在柱子中位居第二,漂移量还小于每只单光子流体,微调或零发. 流出状态然后将稳定的跟踪转变为低漂流. StreamRig看到与链条相同的图像,校正,和被冻结的特征,但通过两者之间的因果历史来读取每台钻机对锚的对接,因此每一次估计都取自更多的证据,而锚地的变化要少得多. 链条在每次跳动时都会重新估计并作成结果,而成份会累积出错误. 即使MA-AB,考虑到每对钻机之间的真实姿势,仍然漂移了46%,因为每对相机估计的微小系统偏差由上千个跳跃组成.

blocks.en: TartanGround stresses the same two ingredients through motion rather than appearance. The simulated robot climbs slopes and crosses vegetation and clutter where occlusions come and go [ 25 ] , so a wide view of the rig and a memory of what was seen both matter. G2G-chain drifts far less than Reloc3R and Rig3R, which are retrained on the target split, so the frozen pre-trained front-end is what carries rig perception to new scenes. The fine-tuned monocular streamers CUT3R and STream3R reach a similar level, which is what a history adds over a single pair. StreamRig combines the two and leads the column.
blocks.zh: TartanGround通过运动而不是外观来强调相同的两种成分. 模拟机器人爬上坡道并跨越了植被和杂乱无章地进出[25],所以对钻机的宽视和对所看到的两个物质的记忆. G2G-链漂流远低于被重新训练在目标分出后被重新训练的Reloc3R和Rig3R,因此被冷冻的前端是将钻机感知带入新场景的. 微调的单流管CUT3R和STream3R达到相近的水平,这是历史在一对相上所添加的. StreamRig将两者结合,并领导栏目.

blocks.en: KITTI-360 is forward driving, the steadiest motion of the four rigs, above all in rotation, and monocular methods do well. CUT3R and STream3R take the second-best translation and rotation drift. Table II isolates the cameras. With the front camera alone our model trails CUT3R, and adding the stereo pair draws level. The second view adds little field of view, but joint perception of two calibrated views carries depth that a single view has to infer. The two side cameras widen the field of view, and the full rig leads among our camera configurations on every metric, including the complete-drive ATE. Across methods in Table I , STream3R reaches the lowest ATE, measured after Sim(3) alignment.
blocks.zh: KITTI-360是向前行驶,是四套钻机最稳健的动作,首先是自转,单相机方法效果良好. CUT3R 和 立体声3 R取倒数第二的翻译和旋转漂移. 表二隔离相机. 单靠前相机 我们的模型跟踪CUT3R 并添加立体对画平面。 第二种观点增加了很少的视野,但是对两种校正观点的共同看法带有一种观点必须推断的深度. 两个侧相机拓宽了视野, 完整的钻机引领我们 的相机配置在每个度量衡, 包括完整的驱动ATE。 在表一各方法中,STream3R达到Sim(3)对齐后测得的最低ATE.

blocks.en: ZJH shows the zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of StreamRig. A walking humanoid is a harder platform than a wheeled one. Every step shakes the rig, and the turn per meter of travel is the largest of the four rigs. On the real humanoid StreamRig has the lowest translation drift, rotation drift, and ATE in the column. Freezing the foundation model lets StreamRig learn rig modeling and odometry in simulation and carries the generalization of the front-end to the real robot. The gain is largest in rotation, where StreamRig lowers the drift of the second-best method, CUT3R, by 63%. The streaming state matters on this platform. CUT3R is ahead of G2G-chain, and the zero-shot streamers LingBot-Map and HorizonStream rank ahead of every non-streaming row except G2G-chain, since a history over many rigs absorbs the perturbation the gait adds to every step.
blocks.zh: ZJH显示"StreamRig"的零发相成真转会. 人行道比轮子平台更难 每一步会摇动钻机,每公尺出行的转弯是四道钻机中最大的. 在真人字"流"(StreamRig)上,列中翻译漂移,自转漂移和ATE最低. 冻结地基模型让StrewRig在模拟中学习钻机模型和平面测量,并搭载了前端对真机器人的概括. 增益最大的是旋转,StrewRig将第二好方法CUT3R的漂移率降低了63%. 流出地州事在本会所. CUT3R领先于G2G-链,零射流克LingBot-Map和HorizonStream排在除G2G-链外的所有非流克行前,因为在许多钻机上的历史吸收了步道所增加的扰动.

blocks.en: IV-C Re-anchoring Distance and Training Horizon
blocks.zh: IV-C 重新确定距离和培训地平线

blocks.en: Re-anchoring distance. Fig. 4 sweeps the re-anchoring block N N over the two complete NCLT sessions. All three models show a U-shaped translation-error curve, with their lowest drift at intermediate blocks. Anchors too close make the trajectory a chain of many short hops, each carrying the noise floor of a single estimate. At larger separations, anchor and query may no longer share a field of view, so their relation must be relayed through the rigs in between, and one-shot pose regression becomes harder as displacement grows. The standard configuration, trained on [ 6 , 48 ] [6,48] rigs, has its lowest translation drift near N = 24 N{=}24 ; drift rises modestly by N = 48 N{=}48 and sharply at N = 64 N{=}64 , beyond its training horizon. Displacement diagnostics support a learned-range limitation: emitted displacements saturate near the largest training displacements as test targets cross that range. The training horizon therefore influences the rising side of the U.
blocks.zh: 复作安隐相. 图4将NN区重新锁定区块扫过NCLT两届完整的会议。 三个模型都显示有U形的翻译-error曲线,中间块的漂移最低. 锁定器太近使轨迹成为一串由许多短跳组成的链条,每个链条都带有单个估计的噪音地层. 在更大的分离中,锚地和查询可能不再共享一个视野,因此它们之间的关系必须通过两者之间的钻机来传递,而一发即成的回归随着迁移的增加而变得更加困难。 该标准配置由[6,48] [6,48]钻机所训练,在N = 24 N {=}24附近有其最低的翻译漂移;漂移由N = 48 N {=}48 适度上升,在N = 64 N{=}64 尖锐地上升,超越了它的训练地平线. 流离失所诊断支持一个学习范围的限制:由于测试目标跨越这一范围,在最大的培训流离失所地点附近排放出流离失所的饱和度。 因此,训练的地平线影响着U的上升面。

blocks.en: Training horizon. Longer-window training shifts the large-block rise to the right, at additional cost. We extend the training windows to [ 6,256 ] [6,256] and [ 6,512 ] [6,512] rigs. The [ 6,256 ] [6,256] model has a broad low-error region at intermediate blocks, but translation drift already rises within its training range and increases sharply from N = 256 N{=}256 to 320. The [ 6,512 ] [6,512] model is evaluated out to N = 768 N{=}768 and rises more gradually beyond its limit, although its translation drift is already high near N = 512 N{=}512 . This gentler rise occurs because its training displacement range already exceeds the separation of the vast majority of frame pairs within individual NCLT trajectories. Longer training thus extends the usable block range without improving the minimum drift or guaranteeing low error throughout the training horizon. At these distances, turns can make anchor-to-query displacement much shorter than the traveled path; the bridge relates the query to the anchor through intervening rigs, while displacement coverage still limits the pose head. This extended range costs training time: the longer models see the same number of rigs per epoch in fewer, longer windows, but use two and three times as many epochs, and hundreds of rigs per window cost more per rig in the long-history mode of Sec. III-D . Estimated RTX 4090 training costs rise from 48 GPU-hours to 270 and 710.
blocks.zh: 训练地平线。 更长时间的窗口培训将大块块向右移动,并增加成本. 我们把训练窗口扩大到[6,256][6,256]和[6,512][6,512]钻机。 [6,256] [6,256] 该型号在中间区块上具有广泛的低热度区域,但翻译漂移量已经在其训练范围内上升,从N=256 N{=}256急剧上升至320. [6,512] [6,512] 该型号被评出为N=768 N{=}768,并更逐渐地超越了它的极限,虽然其翻译漂移已经高到N=512 N{=}512. 出现这种较温和的上升,是因为其训练迁移范围已经超过了NCLT轨迹中绝大多数框架对的分离. 因此,较长的训练延长了可用区块的范围,而没有改进整个训练期间的最低漂移率或保证低误差。 在这些距离上,转弯可以使锚地到平地的移动比行走的路径短得多;桥梁通过介入的钻机将查询与锚地相接,而迁移覆盖仍然限制姿势头. 这种扩展的航程成本培训时间:较长的型号在更少的,更长的窗口中看到每条地段相同的钻机数量,但使用的时间是该地段的2和3倍,而长历史模式的III-D模式下,每条地段的钻机成本会增加数百个. 估计RTX 4090培训费用从48个GPU小时增加到270个和710个小时。

blocks.en: Window curriculum and translation supervision. A far query is related to the anchor through the rigs in between, so an accurate long-range estimate rests on accurate short-range relations in the cached state. The window sampling and translation loss of Sec. III-C control how much gradient the short range receives. A fixed window of 48 rigs weights every target from 1 to 47 hops equally, so the far targets, whose errors are naturally larger, take over the loss. An unnormalized translation loss does the same through displacement, since far targets have larger absolute errors. Either way the near range is under-trained, the far targets then read from an inaccurate state, and the error grows at both ends. Mixed windows and displacement normalization counter this imbalance. The fixed window costs 15 to 30% across the three rigs, a square-root normalization about as much, and no normalization up to twice that. An up-to-scale translation loss in the style of STream3R [ 8 ] , scored with one global scale per sequence like the up-to-scale rows of Table I , has higher translation drift on all three rigs. MapAnything already outputs metric-scale geometry, so StreamRig can be supervised at metric scale, and this supervision improves the trajectory beyond fixing its scale.
blocks.zh: 窗口课程和翻译监督. 远端的查询与通过中间的钻机的锚有关,因此准确的远程估计依赖于缓存状态中准确的短程关系. Sec. III-C的窗口采样和翻译丢失控制了短距离得到多少梯度. 一个48个钻机的固定窗口将每个目标从1到47个跳板等重,因此远期目标(其出错自然较大)接管了损失. 由于远方目标有较大的绝对错误,非正常的翻译损失通过迁移也一样。 无论哪种方式,近距离都训练不足,远目标从不准确的状态读取,而误差在两端会增加. 混合窗口和流离失所正常化抵消了这种不平衡。 固定的窗户花费了15-30% 跨越了三套钻机,一个平方根的正常化 大约是两倍。 STream3R [8] 风格的上下级翻译损失,得分与表一的上下级一行一样,每行各一个全球尺度,这三种钻机的翻译漂移率都更高. 映射任何已经输出出度量衡几何,所以StreamRig可以在度量衡中被监督,这种监督可以改善轨迹,超越了测量尺度.

blocks.en: Anchor snapshot. Replacing the per-query snapshot of Sec. III-B with a static anchor costs 9 to 38% across the three rigs. A static anchor is read by the query but remains query-independent throughout the bridge. The snapshot lets the two rigs attend to each other through the whole bridge, where the relative pose is resolved.
blocks.zh: 锁定快照。 取代每克快照的Sec. III-B 以静态起锚在三台钻机上耗资9-38%. 一个静态锚被查询读取,但在整个桥梁中仍然保持查询的独立性. 该快照让两台钻机通过整座桥相接相接相接,相对姿势被解决.

blocks.en: Latents per camera. Halving the latents from 16 to 8 costs up to 18% in translation. Doubling them to 32 leaves translation within a few percent and lowers rotation drift by about a quarter on NCLT and TartanGround, at about three times the training compute, so we keep 16 per camera.
blocks.zh: 每台相机都装有护身符 将潜伏物从16个降到8个 翻译成本高达18% 把它们翻到32分, 翻译在几分之内, 将NCLT和TartanGround的旋转速度 降低约四分之一, 大约是训练的三倍, 所以我们保留每台相机16分。

blocks.en: Temporal position code. A rotary temporal code brings no gain on any rig, and translation drifts up to 8% more than with the code-free bridge. A monocular streamer recovers geometry across time from single frames, so it must know which frames lie close in time, and LingBot-Map loses clearly without the rotary code in its trajectory memory [ 9 ] . StreamRig resolves geometry inside each rig with the frozen front-end, and the anchor snapshot names the reference rig explicitly, so the bridge only relates rig-level observations and needs no order beyond the causal mask.
blocks.zh: 临时位置代码。 旋转时间代码不会给任何钻机带来任何好处,翻译漂移比无密码桥多出8%. 单子流体从单相框中恢复了跨时相位几何,因此它必须知道哪个相框在时间相近,而LingBot-Map在其轨迹内存中没有回旋码明显地丢失. [9]. StreamRig用被冷冻的前端解决了每个钻机内部的几何,而锚地快照则明确命名了参考钻机,因此桥只连接了钻机平面观测,不需要超出因果口罩的命令.

blocks.en: Initialization. Removing Stage I increases translation drift by approximately 4.6–14.9 × \times under the same training setup. Frozen geometric features alone therefore do not yield an effective pose readout when trained from scratch. Group relocalization on diverse layouts and displacements teaches the back-end to align geometric features before causal adaptation to a fixed rig (Sec. III-C ).
blocks.zh: 初释. 删除阶段 我增加翻译时间, 因此,单是冰冻的几何特征并不能在从零开始训练时产生有效的姿势读出。 组合在不同的布局和相位上重新定位,教导后端在因果地适应固定钻机之前,调整几何特征(Sec. III-C.

blocks.en: Frozen front-end. Table IV tests the front-end interface of Sec. III-A by substituting Depth Anything 3 [ 17 ] or π 3 \pi^{3} X [ 16 ] . Both alternatives converge, stream, and trace the same U over N N . The three front-ends differ in how directly they expose intra-rig geometry to the readout, with per-pixel ray conditioning the most direct, and we read their ordering as a statement about that rather than about model size.
blocks.zh: 被冻前端. 表四测试了Sec.III-A的前端接口,取而代之的是深度Anything 3 [17] 或 3\pi^{3} X [16]. 两种替代品都汇合,流出,并用NN来追踪同样的U. 三个前端在如何直接将硬体内几何特征暴露在读取中上,每个像素的射线调节最直接,我们读到它们的订单时,是对这个而不是模型大小的说明.

blocks.en: IV-E Compute and Memory Budget
blocks.zh: 四-E 计算和记忆预算

blocks.en: TABLE V: COMPUTE AND MEMORY BUDGET PER ARRIVAL.
blocks.zh: 表五: 计算和计算预算

blocks.en: Figure 1 uses NCLT 2012-08-20 for accuracy, with StreamRig at N = 24 N=24 and fine-tuned CUT3R using a nine-frame window. Its costs are measured separately on an RTX 4090 with BF16 and batch size one, using StreamRig at N = 2 N=2 and recurrent CUT3R. The plotted LiDAR points visualize the estimated poses and are not odometry inputs.
blocks.zh: 图1采用了NCLT 2012-08-20的精度,StreamRig at N = 24 N = 24,并使用九帧窗口对CUT3R进行微调. 其成本在一台装有BF16和批量尺寸一的RTX 4090上分别计量,使用StreamRig = 2 N=2和经常性CUT3R. 所绘制的LiDAR指向可视化估计的外观而并非斜面输入.

blocks.en: Table V measures every method on the same GPU with the same inputs resident in memory, from RGB to pose, over 512 arrivals. StreamRig processes a five-camera rig in 26.2 ms with 2.6 GiB, whereas CUT3R, the fastest monocular streamer, spends 31.3 ms and 3.9 GiB on one frame. The window-based and long-context streamers cost several times more. Perception dominates. The frozen backbone and the Rig-Resampler take 24.9 of the 26.2 ms and the CausalBridge with the pose head about 1.3 ms, so the temporal module is almost free and the marginal cost of a camera is the cost of perceiving it.
blocks.zh: 表五对同一GPU上的每一种方法进行测量,从RGB到站内输入的相同输入,超过512人。 StreamRig在26.2 ms和2.6 GiB处理出一款五相机钻机,而CUT3R作为最快的单相机在一帧上花费了31.3 ms和3.9 GiB. 以窗口为基础的和长通文字的流线器成本是数倍. 觉相为主. 被冻结的骨干和Rig-Resampler取取出26.2 ms中的24.9分,而Causal Bridge取出外形头部约1.3 ms,因此时间模块几乎是免费的,相机的边际成本是透视成本.

blocks.en: A pairwise chain that re-encodes both rigs of every pair costs 1.9 times more, but a chain that caches the features of the previous rig does exactly the work of StreamRig at N = 2 N{=}2 , so the gain of Table I is accuracy at equal cost, not speed. The optional long-history mode keeps the whole history addressable at the same per-step latency, but its state grows with the sequence and peaks at 3.0 GiB after 512 rigs. Bounded memory comes from re-anchoring, not from compression alone.
blocks.zh: 重编码每对相机两台相机的对接链成本为1.9倍,但缓存上一对相机特征的连接链在N = 2 N {=}2 时恰好完成了StrewRig的工作,因此表一的得分是等价的精度,而不是速度. 可选的长历史模式将整个历史的可地址保持在每步相仿的空档上,但其状态随着序列和峰值在512个钻机后以3.0 GiB相接而增长. 被捆绑的记忆来源于再沉淀,而不只是从压缩.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: The results of StreamRig support joint rig perception and temporal history as complementary sources of odometry accuracy. The Rig-Resampler and CausalBridge make this combination affordable, while group relocalization provides the alignment initialization that limited rig data alone does not supply. The re-anchoring study shows that longer training windows extend the usable anchor range. Effective streaming combines compact geometric observations with an appropriate re-anchoring interval.
blocks.zh: StreamRig的结果支持了联合钻机感知和时间历史,作为测量精度的补充来源. Rig-Resampler和CausalBridge使这种组合价格低廉,而组合重新定位则提供配对初始化,即仅有限的钻机数据不能提供. 重新定位的研究表明,较长的训练窗口扩展了可用的锚地范围. 有效的相流结合了紧凑的几何观测和适当的重排间隔.

blocks.en: Future work. Exploratory trials on NCLT suggest that compressed rig tokens may be useful for same-session revisit retrieval, but we do not quantitatively evaluate this capability here, and acceptance thresholds still require per-session tuning. We will develop transferable loop triggers and integrate revisits into the streaming state. We will also jointly refine poses and dense geometry so that the accumulated map constrains subsequent estimates.
blocks.zh: 未来工作。 对NCLT的探索性试验表明,压缩钻机令牌可能对同场复议检索有用,但我们在此不从数量上评价这种能力,接受阈值仍需要每场复议一次。 我们将开发可转移回路触发器,并将再入流态. 我们还将共同改进外观和密集的几何结构,使所积累的地图限制随后的估计。
